annotations.title: Get per-keyword SERP overview with tracked history/volatility

description: Per-keyword SERP overview: a fresh live SERP snapshot for the keyword, PLUS — when this exact keyword happens to already be tracked in this project's rank tracking — its historical position trend and SERP volatility, read straight from the SAME rank-tracking services (`get_rank_keyword_history`/`get_rank_volatility_index`) already use. `tracked.isTracked: false` means this keyword is not currently tracked in any of the project's active rank-tracking configs — an honest absence, never a fabricated trend. One upstream call (the live SERP fetch, cached 12h); the rank-tracking portion is DB-only reads. `sinceDays` only affects `tracked.history` and is ignored when the keyword is not tracked.

languageCode.description: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Omit it to use the project's default market language, which falls back to 'en'.

locationCode.description: DataForSEO location code. Omit it to use the project's default market, which falls back to 2840 (United States) for a project that has not set one. See dataforseo.com/help-center/locations. Some countries (e.g. Iceland, 2352) are served from Google Ads data: keyword volume/CPC/trends work, but keyword difficulty, search intent, and domain analytics are unavailable.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

sinceDays.description: How many days of tracked history to return, 1-730 (default 365). Only meaningful when the keyword is tracked.

name: get_keyword_serp_overview
